ds2.1.1:92.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhavyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññā-āloko paññā-obhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanam amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.1.1:93.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā manoviññāṇadhātu --
ds2.1.1:94.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā --
ds2.1.1:95.2: Yo tesaṃ arūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ --
ds2.1.1:96.1: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye pañcaṅgikaṃ jhānaṃ hoti?
ds2.1.1:96.2: Vitakko, vicāro, pīti, sukhaṃ, cittass' ekaggatā. 84.
ds2.1.1:97.2: Yo tasmiṃ samaye takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā vyappanā cetaso abhiniropanā sammāsaṅkappo --
ds2.1.1:98.2: Yo tasmiṃ samaye cāro vicāro anuvicāro upavicāro cittassa anusandhanatā anupekkhanatā --
ds2.1.1:99.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye pīti pāmojjaṃ āmodanā pamodanā hāso pahāso vitti odagyaṃ attamanatā cittassa --
ds2.1.1:100.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā --
ds2.1.1:101.1: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye cittass' ekaggatā hoti?
ds2.1.1:101.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi --
ds2.1.1:101.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittass' ekaggatā hoti.
ds2.1.1:101.4: Idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye pañcaṅgikaṃ jhānaṃ hoti. 89.
ds2.1.1:102.1: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye pañcaṅgiko maggo hoti?
ds2.1.1:103.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā pandiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhavyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññā-āloko paññā-obhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.1.1:104.2: Yo tasmiṃ samaye takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā vyappanā cetaso abhiniropanā sammāsaṅkappo --
ds2.1.1:105.2: Yo tasmiṃ samaye cetasiko viriyārambho nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhi thāmo dhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittachandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggāho viriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ viriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo --
ds2.1.1:106.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhā raṇatā apilāpanatā asammussanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati --
ds2.1.1:107.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi --
ds2.1.1:107.4: Ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye pañcaṅgiko maggo hoti. 95.
ds2.1.1:108.1: Katamāni tasmiṃ samaye satta balāni honti?
ds2.1.1:108.2: Saddhābalaṃ, viriyabalaṃ, satibalaṃ, samādhibalaṃ, paññābalaṃ hiribalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ. 96.
ds2.1.1:109.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye saddhā saddahanā okappanā abhippasādo saddhā saddhindriyaṃ saddhābalaṃ --
ds2.1.1:110.2: Yo tasmiṃ samaye cetasiko viriyārambho nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhi thāmo dhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittachandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggāho viriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ viriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo.
ds2.1.1:111.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asammussanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati --
ds2.1.1:112.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasaṭā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi --
ds2.1.1:113.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhavyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññā āloko paññā-obhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.1.1:114.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye hiriyati hiriyitabbena hiriyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā --
ds2.1.1:115.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ottappati ottappitabbena ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā --
ds2.1.1:115.4: Imāmi tasmiṃ samaye satta balāni honti. 103.
ds2.1.1:116.1: Katame tasmiṃ samaye tayo hetū honti?

ds2.1.1:118.2: Yo tasmiṃ samaye adoso adussanā adussitattaṃ avyāpādo avyāpajjo adoso kusalamūlaṃ --
ds2.1.1:119.2: Ya tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā . . . pe (43) . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.1.1:119.4: Ime tasmiṃ samaye tayo hetū honti. 107.
ds2.1.1:120.1: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye eko passo hoti?
ds2.1.1:120.2: Yo tasmiṃ samaye phasso phusanā samphusanā samphusi- tattaṃ --
ds2.1.1:120.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye eko phasso hoti. 108.
ds2.1.1:121.1: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye ekā vedanā hoti?
ds2.1.1:121.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā --
ds2.1.1:121.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekā vedanā hoti. 109.
ds2.1.1:122.1: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye ekā saññā hoti?
ds2.1.1:122.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye saññā sañjānanā sañjānitattaṃ
ds2.1.1:122.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekā saññā hoti. 110.
ds2.1.1:123.1: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye ekā cetanā hoti?
ds2.1.1:123.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye cetamā sañcetanā cetayitattaṃ --
ds2.1.1:123.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekā cetanā hoti. 111.
ds2.1.1:124.1: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekaṃ cittaṃ hoti?
ds2.1.1:124.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā mamoviññāṇadhātu --
ds2.1.1:124.3: idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekaṃ cittaṃ hoti. 112.
ds2.1.1:125.1: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye eko vedanākkhandho hoti?
ds2.1.1:125.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā --
ds2.1.1:125.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye eko vedanākkhandho hoti. 113.
ds2.1.1:126.1: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye eko saññākkhandho hoti?
ds2.1.1:126.2: Yā tasmiṃ samaye saññā sañjānanā sañjānitattaṃ --
ds2.1.1:126.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye eko saññākkhandho hoti. 114.
ds2.1.1:127.1: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye eko saṅkhārakkhandho hoti?
ds2.1.1:127.2: Phasso vedanā vitakko vicāro pīti cittass' ekaggatā saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ paññidriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi saddhābalaṃ viriyabalaṃ satibalaṃ samādhibalaṃ paññābalaṃ hiribalaṃ ottappabalaṃ alobho adoso amoho anabhijjhā avyāpādo sammādiṭṭhi hiri ottappaṃ kāyapassaddhi cittapassaddhi kāyalahutā cittalahutā kāyamudutā cittamudutā kāyakammaññatā cittakammaññatā kāyapāguññatā cittapāguññatā kāyujjukatā cittujjukatā sati sampajaññaṃ samatho vipassanā paggāho avikkhepo --
ds2.1.1:127.3: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā, ṭhapetvā vedanākkhandhaṃ ṭhapetvā saññākkhandhaṃ ṭhapetvā viññāṇakkhandhaṃ --
ds2.1.1:127.4: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye eko saṅkhārakkhandho hoti. 115.
ds2.1.1:128.1: Katamo tasmiṃ samaye eko viññāṇakkhandho hoti?
ds2.1.1:128.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā manoviññāṇadhātu --
ds2.1.1:128.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye eko viññāṇakkhandho hoti. 116.
ds2.1.1:129.1: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekaṃ manāyatanaṃ hoti?
ds2.1.1:129.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññaṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā manoviññāṇadhātu --
ds2.1.1:129.3: idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekaṃ manāyatanaṃ hoti. 117.
ds2.1.1:130.1: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekaṃ manindriyaṃ hoti?
ds2.1.1:130.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā manoviññāṇadhātu --
ds2.1.1:130.3: idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekaṃ manindriyaṃ hoti. 118.
ds2.1.1:131.1: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye ekā manoviññāṇadhātu hoti?
ds2.1.1:131.2: Yaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ mano mānasaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍaraṃ mano manāyatanaṃ manindriyaṃ viññaṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandho tajjā manoviññāṇadhātu --
ds2.1.1:131.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekā manoviññāṇadhātu hoti. 119.
ds2.1.1:132.1: Katamaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ hoti?
ds2.1.1:132.3: idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ hoti. 120.
ds2.1.1:133.1: Katamā tasmiṃ samaye ekā dhammadhātu hoti?
ds2.1.1:133.3: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye ekā dhammadhātu hoti.

ds2.1.1:135.1: Tasmiṃ kho pana samaye dhammā honti, khandhā honti, āyatanāni honti, dhātuyo honti, āhārā honti, indriyāni honti, jhānaṃ hoti, maggo hoti, balāni honti, hetū honti, phasso hoti, vedanā hoti, saññā hoti, cetanā hoti, cittaṃ hoti, vedanākkhandho hoti, saññākkhandho hoti,saṅkhārakkhandho hoti, viññāṇakkhandho hoti, manāyatanaṃ hoti, manindriyaṃ hoti, manoviññāṇadhātu hoti, dhammāyatanaṃ hoti, dhammadhātu hoti,
ds2.1.1:135.2: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā --
ds2.1.1:141.2: Saddhindriyaṃ, viriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ paññindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ, somanassindriyaṃ, jīvitindriyaṃ --
ds2.1.1:142.2: Vitakko vicāro pīti sukhaṃ cittass' ekaggatā --
ds2.1.1:144.2: Saddhābalaṃ, viriyabalaṃ, satibalaṃ, samādhibalaṃ, paññābalaṃ, hiribalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ --
ds2.1.1:160.1: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā --

ds2.1.1:161.3: dhammārammaṇaṃ vā, yaṃ yaṃ vā pan' ārabbha tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti . . . pe (147) . . . avikkhepo hoti . . . pe (147) . . .

ds2.1.1:162.3: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammāime
ds2.1.1:163.1: Tasmiṃ kho pano samaye cattāro khandhā honti; dvāyatanāni honti, dve dhātuyo honti, tayo āhārā honti, sattindriyāni honti, pañcaṅgikaṃ jhānaṃ hoti, caturaṅgiko maggo hoti, cha balāni honti, dve hetū honti, eko phasso hoti . . . pe (58) . . . ekaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ hoti, ekā dhammadhātu hoti,

ds2.1.1:164.6: Tatiyaṃ. 148. Katamo tasmiṃ samaye saṅkhārakkhandho hoti? Phasso . . . pe (62) . . . saṅkhārakkhandho hoti . . . pe . . . ime dhammā kusalā. 149.

ds2.1.1:170.3: idaṃ tasmiṃ samaye upekkhindriyaṃ hoti . . . pe . . .

ds2.1.1:174.2: Yasmiṃ samaye kāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ hoti, upekkhāsahagataṃ ñāṇasampayuttaṃ sasaṅkhāreṇa rūpārammaṇaṃ vā . . . pe . . .
ds2.1.1:174.3: dhammārammaṇaṃ vā, yaṃ yaṃ vā pan' ārabbha tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti . . . pe . . . avikkhepo hoti . . .
ds2.1.1:175.2: Yasmiṃ samaye kāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ hoti upekkhāsahagataṃ ñāṇavippayuttaṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ vā saddārammaṇaṃ vā gandhārammaṇaṃ vā rasārammaṇaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbārammaṇaṃ vā dhammārammaṇaṃ vā, yaṃ yaṃ vā panārabbha, tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti, vedanā hoti, saññā hoti, cetanā hoti, cittaṃ hoti, vitakko hoti, vicāro hoti, upekkhā hoti, cittass' ekaggatā hoti, saddhindriyaṃ hoti, viriyindriyaṃ hoti, satindriyaṃ hoti, samādhindriyaṃ hoti, ñāṇindriyaṃ hoti, upekkhindriyaṃ hoti, jīvitindriyaṃ hoti, sammāsaṅkappo hoti, sammāvāyāmo ghoti, sammāsati hoti, sammāsamādhi hoti, saddhābalaṃ hoti, viriyabalaṃ hoti, satibalaṃ hoti, samādhibalaṃ hoti, hiribalaṃ hoti, ottappabalaṃ hoti, alobho hoti, adoso hoti, anabhijjhā hoti, avyāpādo hoti, hiri hoti, ottappaṃ hoti, kāyapassaddhi hoti, cittapassaddhi hoti, kāyalahutā hoti, cittalahutā hoti, kāyamudutā hoti, cittamudutā hoti, kāyakāmmaññatā hoti, cittakammaññatā hoti, kāyapāguññatā hoti, cittapāguññatā hoti, kāyujjukatā hoti, cittujjukatā hoti, sati hoti, sampajaññaṃ hoti, samatho hoti, paggāho hoti, avikkhepe hoti;
ds2.1.1:175.3: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā --
ds2.1.1:176.1: Tasmiṃ kho pana samaye cattāro khandhā honti, dvāyatanāni honti, dve dhātuyo honti, tayo āhārā honti, sattindriyāni honti, caturaṅgikaṃ jhānaṃ hoti, caturaṅgiko maggo hoti, cha balāni honti, dve hetū honti, eko phasso hoti . . . pe (58) . . . ekaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ hoti, ekā dhammadhātu hoti --
ds2.1.1:176.2: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā --
ds2.1.1:177.2: Phasso cetanā vitakko vicāro cittass' ekaggatā saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ sammāsaṅkappo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati, sammāsamādhi, saddhābalaṃ, viriyabalaṃ, satibalaṃ, samādhibalaṃ, hiribalaṃ ottappabalaṃ, alobho, adoso, anabhijjhā, avyāpādo, hiri, ottappaṃ, kāyapassaddhi, cittapassaddhi, kāyalahutā, cittalahutā, kāyamudutā, cittamudutā, kāyakammaññatā, cittakammaññatā, kāyapāguññatā, cittapāguññatā, kāyujjukatā, cittujjukatā, sati, samatho, paggāho, avikkhepo,
ds2.1.1:178.1: ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā, ṭhapetvā vedanākkhandhaṃ, ṭhapetvā saññākkhandhaṃ, ṭhapetvā viññāṇakkhandhaṃ;
ds2.1.1:178.2: ayaṃ tasmiṃ samaye saṅkhārakkhandho hoti, ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā --
